description: Mara Venn left careful map margins for people she would never meet, then quietly crossed her own name off every completed repair. This book follows her example: learn the boundaries first, then leave room for the world to become yours.
quests.subtitle: Orientation · First steps
quests.title: Welcome Aboard

description: Clear claims let homes and public works grow without surprise damage. When boundaries are visible, neighbors can build beside one another with confidence and disputes have somewhere fair to begin.
quests.subtitle: Required rule · Land claims
quests.title: Claim Your Ground

description: Rivalry stays worth playing only when consent and lasting work remain intact. That boundary makes room for hunters, vampires, and protected neighbors to share one persistent world.
quests.subtitle: Required rule · Engagement
quests.title: Rivalry Without Ruin

description: A team ties progress and claimed ground to the people you trust, while clear trades turn one player's surplus into another's next project. With those expectations settled, every campaign lane remains open.
quests.subtitle: Teams · Trade and claims
quests.title: Teams and Trade

description: The feud offers two transformations, while protected neutrality leaves room for builders, traders, and wanderers. Each identity changes how the world feels without closing another chapter, so curiosity can outlast the first choice.
quests.subtitle: Overview · Identity paths
quests.title: Three Open Roads

description: Nightbound life exchanges daylight ease for blood-fed power and a different way of reading the world. The Coven's field guide stays open to curious players, so identity shapes play without sealing content away.
quests.subtitle: Vampire path · Transformation
quests.title: Nightbound Path

description: Hunter discipline trades easy neutrality for tools and responsibilities aimed at night threats. The Order's field guide remains open to anyone who wants to understand that practice.
quests.subtitle: Hunter path · Initiation
quests.title: Hunter's Oath

description: Protected neutrality keeps farms, workshops, trade routes, and quiet homes outside the feud. Honoring that boundary gives both factions a neighbor instead of another target, while every civic and learning route stays open.
quests.subtitle: Civic path · Protected neutral
quests.title: Protected Neutrality

description: Tamsin Rook keeps one blunt reminder above the bench after once choosing the wrong door. Its lesson is caution: a prepared workshop gives the next patrol time to think, and sacred brewing makes that refuge more than a place to hide.
quests.subtitle: Order path · Foundation
quests.title: Hunter's Bench

description: Distance can decide whether a patrol returns safely, and a stocked refuge gives frightened travelers another answer besides flight. Once that service is dependable, the weapon workshop can support harder roads.
quests.subtitle: Order path · Brewing
quests.title: Sacred Brewing

description: Stronger night threats punish improvised gear and thin supply lines. A mature arsenal lets patrols meet danger at range, then pass reliable equipment to whoever takes the next watch.
quests.subtitle: Order path · Arsenal
quests.title: Siege Arsenal

description: Tamsin Rook calls a masterwork useful only when the least experienced patrol member can trust it. Meeting that standard leaves the Order a repeatable practice, and the warding kit opens wider travel.
quests.subtitle: Order path · Masterwork
quests.title: Order's Masterwork

description: Holy practice matters when healing and protection are available before a patrol turns desperate. A complete discipline lets the workshop teach new casters and broadens the Order's response beyond steel.
quests.subtitle: Specialist · Holy practice
quests.title: Holy Arsenal

description: Power that keeps moving after a patrol leaves turns a private workshop into dependable infrastructure. The expanded maintenance stock lets another line branch from the same works.
quests.subtitle: Specialist · Workshop power
quests.title: Siege Engineering

description: A visible watchpost gives travelers a refuge and patrols a place to leave warnings. Once established, it becomes a shared landmark that later builders can reinforce rather than replace.
quests.subtitle: Specialist · Public watch
quests.title: Raise the Watch

description: Ivo Mire records the nights he chose hunger over breaking a neighbor's trust in dry, exact handwriting. A measured refuge makes that restraint sustainable, and the next rite can begin without secrecy becoming an excuse.
quests.subtitle: Coven path · Foundation
quests.title: Night's Shelter

description: A coven lasts when appetite becomes a managed responsibility instead of a private emergency. Shared stores give later rites a steady foundation and leave fewer desperate choices for the next visitor.
quests.subtitle: Coven path · Bloodwork
quests.title: Bloodwork Altars

description: Infusion turns costly bloodwork into a practice that can be taught and repeated. A stable rite makes stronger relics possible without treating hunger as permission to harm a neighbor.
quests.subtitle: Coven path · Infusion
quests.title: Infused Arsenal

description: Ivo Mire leaves the cleanest line on his masterwork page for what he refused to take. That restraint gives the coven a standard worth inheriting, while the finished work opens wider travel and deeper study.
quests.subtitle: Coven path · Masterwork
quests.title: Coven's Masterwork

description: Bloodbound study becomes safer when its costs are recorded and its lessons remain legible to the next caster. A complete practice widens the coven's repertoire without making raw power its only measure.
quests.subtitle: Specialist · Blood practice
quests.title: Bloodbound Arcana

description: A coven workshop should keep its rhythm through the hours when its keepers rest. Dependable motion turns private machines into a service others can extend.
quests.subtitle: Specialist · Workshop power
quests.title: Sanguine Industry

description: A manor is a refuge with a clear threshold, not a claim over the night. Once established, it gives visitors a place they may enter or avoid by choice, and later builders a structure worth maintaining.
quests.subtitle: Specialist · Shared refuge
quests.title: Raise the Manor

description: Mara Venn marked structures she could return to, not every horizon she could name. A reliable compass turns a rumor into a route the next traveler can follow.
quests.subtitle: Exploration · Find a route
quests.title: Surveyor's Kit

description: A route survives memory when someone records the view that made it worth walking. Once the shutter opens, later records can preserve places instead of coordinates alone.
quests.subtitle: Fieldwork · First photograph
quests.title: First Exposure

description: Loose photographs vanish into chests and unlabeled barrels. An ordered record gives a route witnesses, context, and a reason to be visited again.
quests.subtitle: Fieldwork · Printed photograph
quests.title: Moment in Time

description: Private discoveries become common knowledge when their evidence has a home. A public field record gives future roads names, caretakers, and proof of what waits at the end.
&eAttestation: &fShare four photographs from distinct public sites in an album or display that other players can reach.
quests.subtitle: Exploration · Shared archive
quests.title: Island Album

description: Visible power gives a public workshop an obvious beginning and a service newcomers can understand. The checkmark attests that you powered a site intended for shared use; its first transmission opens the route to a second source.
quests.subtitle: Public works · Wind power
quests.title: Raise the Sails

description: A second source makes the public network less fragile and easier to extend across awkward terrain. The checkmark attests that you connected it to shared power; the routing bundle prepares the next service.
quests.subtitle: Public works · Water power
quests.title: Turn the Wheel

description: A foundry becomes public infrastructure when visitors can rely on it for useful work. The checkmark attests that you performed the work at the shared site; the support stock lets another service branch from the same ledger.
quests.subtitle: Public works · Foundry
quests.title: Press Together

description: A public line saves neighbors from rebuilding the same workshop and gives complicated parts a known home. The checkmark attests that you produced an output on the shared line; maintenance supplies keep the service available to later visitors.
quests.subtitle: Public works · Assembly
quests.title: Assembly Line

description: Mara Venn left the signal tower's broadest margin blank for builders she would never meet. When newcomers can find shelter, services, and the next caretaker there, the island gains infrastructure that can be extended instead of replaced.
quests.subtitle: Public works · Shared landmark
quests.title: Shared Landmark

description: Requisitions turn earned Bevels into practical supplies for a team that wants to keep building. Each crate returns on a seven-day rhythm, giving shared projects a steady fallback without replacing ordinary play.
quests.subtitle: Team crates for spent Bevels
quests.title: Open Requisitions

description: Interior finishes and warm light make public rooms easier to read and more inviting to return to. This crate supports the next durable shared build.
quests.subtitle: Costs 4 Bevels • Once per team each week
quests.title: Builder's Crate

description: A reliable supply of inscription materials lets the team repair gaps in its spellwork service without waiting on one specialist. The next lesson can begin while the workshop restocks.
quests.subtitle: Costs 4 Bevels • Once per team each week
quests.title: Spellwright's Crate

description: Film and display frames keep the public archive growing after its first pages are filled. A team can document another route without rebuilding the darkroom supply from nothing.
quests.subtitle: Costs 3 Bevels • Once per team each week
quests.title: Archivist's Crate

description: Travel supplies keep survey routes moving and give animals or cargo a safe handoff. A team can reopen an old road without starting its logistics from nothing.
quests.subtitle: Costs 3 Bevels • Once per team each week
quests.title: Wayfarer's Crate

description: Ordinary workshop stock makes extensions and repairs easy to share across specialties. The public line can keep serving players while its next branch is planned.
quests.subtitle: Costs 5 Bevels • Once per team each week
quests.title: Workshop Crate
